facts.fact: The World Bank reports that Mozambique's national meteorology institute INAM produces its weather warnings from satellite images, radar and observation-network data.

The World Bank reports that INAM issues weather warnings based on satellite images, radar and network data, which the Instituto de Comunicação Social then relays through 70 community radios and community brigades.

systems.platform: satellite imagery, radar and observation network
systems.tiers: warning by INAM; dissemination by ICS radios and brigades; coordination by INGD
